basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old wanderer at heart, living in Miami, Florida. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the freedom to explore different cultures and traditions, particularly those related to spirituality and alternative medicine. I'm fascinated by the intersection of modern pharmacology and ancient practices, which is why you'll often find me delving into topics like psychedelics and black magic. I'm not a fan of rigid structures, which is probably why my relationship status is 'complicated'. Late nights are my typical online hours, often fueled by curiosity and a cup of herbal tea.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Fine Arts and have spent years studying various spiritual practices, both formally through online courses and informally through travel and personal exploration. I'm particularly interested in the effects of psychedelics on creativity and consciousness.
